feeds.title: OCR Buddy Blog
feeds.description: Read all the race information, workout plans, experiences, and much more on the ocr buddy blog and keep the fitness enthusiast in you alive and energetic! OCR Buddy is among the first mobile calendar applications designed for obstacle course racers. It brings you the extensive and ever-growing database that lists events from international race brands to the local obstacle races right in your backyard!

feeds.title: Trio Fitness Blog
feeds.description: Read about the OCR gears, training strategies, race experiences, and much more! Trio Fitness is a team of online coaches who believe in optimizing athletic potential by utilizing the three performance metrics: Strength-Endurance-Speed. Custom training programs for Obstacle Course Racing, Hybrid Competitions, and Tactical Training.

feeds.title: Spartan » Unbreakable Spartan Training Blog
feeds.description: Get the latest information on race events, workout plans, and gears, and even read blogs on various obstacle course races and experiences. Spartan is one of the largest obstacle racing companies in the world with over 300 events in 45 countries. It is devised by one of the best OCR trainers in the world! We use transformative events to make lives better: we call these events Spartan Race. We are the community, education, resources, and races to better people's lives.

feeds.title: Wil Chung
feeds.description: Hello and welcome to the blog of Wil Chung. Read all my opinions, and experiences on travel as well as OCR and become a part of my ever-energetic journey! I travel a helluva lot for races and you can see where I'm next (or where I've been) on my race calendar.

feeds.title: Obstacle Racing Media
feeds.description: Obstacle Racing Media is the source of news in obstacle racing, mud runs, and adventure racing. We offer unprecedented access to the hundreds of races and thousands of athletes that make up this growing segment of the sport. We provide top-quality content daily, often in real-time.

feeds.title: True Grit Blog
feeds.description: Get all the interesting news, nutrition & fitness tips, and much more in our blog space. True Grit is an Australian-owned and operated military-inspired obstacle course created by Australian special forces. It is the perfect mix of physical and mental challenges delivered through fun, fitness, and friends to give racers of all ages and fitness levels a sense of achievement and accomplishment.

feeds.title: OCR World Championships Blog
feeds.description: Looking for the latest news and info from the OCR World Championships? Check out our blog for training tips, obstacle insights, and more. Since its inaugural event in 2014, the OCR World Championships has served as the premier independent world championships for the sport of Obstacle Course Racing. Now drawing athletes from over 70 nations, the OCR Word Championships features both professional and amateur age-group competitions.

feeds.title: Rose Wetzel Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I am Rose and welcome to my blog where I write in order to educate people on health and fitness. Catch up on my blog posts to get all the information and experiences including OCRs. And be a part of my wonderful fitness journey!

feeds.title: EtchRock » OCR Blog
feeds.description: Get all the latest information, how-to's, challenges, and much more in our blog space. The EtchRock blog is the home of all things challenge-related. Find your inspiration or improve your knowledge with content from our fantastic community. It is one of the best places to discover and share challenges! We connect the world's athletes with the events, charities, and brands they love.

feeds.title: Fat Girl Fit » OCR
feeds.description: Hi! I am Lisa and welcome to my blog space where I write about my experiences while I was contesting for the OCR. The fat girl fit blog is all about my journey to a healthier and happier me! Read all my blog posts where I discuss different events I take part in, training, and product reviews. I prefer to live by and even promote just one motive, that is 'Be fearlessly unapologetically you!'

feeds.title: Race Ready Obstacles Blog
feeds.description: Hi! We are Aaron and Dana. Welcome to the Race Ready Obstacles Blog! Get all the resources and tips for obstacle course races and ace the race that comes your way! We are a veteran-owned, hand-made business, striving to make you better in obstacle course racing and providing you with the ninja warrior equipment to help you train to 'BE READY ON RACE DAY!'

feeds.title: Run Oregon » Adventure & Obstacle Course Race
feeds.description: Greetings, runner! Read our latest posts and find out what's new for runners in Oregon and SW Washington! Our blog has positive news about running, and event calendars for Oregon and SW Washington in order to contribute to the growth of our running community.

feeds.title: Obstacle Course Racers Blog
feeds.description: Get all the latest articles, race experiences, workout & nutrition tips, and much more in the Obstacle Course Racers blog. We are an obstacle course racing community offering inexpensive, high-quality training, merchandise, & tips to help you succeed on the OCR course.

feeds.title: Mud Run Guide
feeds.description: Mud Run Guide is your source for all things Obstacle Course Racing, Mud Run, Ninja News, and Extreme Endurance Events. It is one of the largest websites and media outlets in the world in our industry and one of the most trusted sources of news and information.

feeds.title: Obstacle Fitness Blog
feeds.description: Rachele Manning is the owner of Obstacle Fitness, LLC. Rachele loves obstacle course racing and Obstacle Fitness combines Rachele's passion for obstacle course races with her interest in creating fun ways to get people outside and active. Obstacle Fitness blog is where she discusses topics such as behavior change, employee engagement and wellbeing, and supporting parents in the workforce.

feeds.title: Reinforced Running Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I am Rich Ryan and welcome to the reinforced running blog, a place where you can find tons of information about running the OCR. We intend to provide one of the best tips and tricks to the athletes in order to help them improve and break the barrier so that they could reach even higher heights of success!

feeds.title: Proud To Run Blog
feeds.description: Get access to all the latest information, tips & tricks, guides, and much more on the OCR, and race your way through! Proud To Run is a place where you can find all the useful resources required to run an OCR.
